intro1: ONDA Life is an HRV biofeedback and guided-breathing app for real-time physiological self-regulation and nervous-system training. Around that core sits a broader system of mindfulness and self-development practices for real life:
introList: levels: from body support to higher states of consciousness;
internal currency OND for practices and missions.
intro2: Path: from body sensation — to clarity, inspiration, and strength.
disclaimer: The evidence-backed part of ONDA is HRV biofeedback and paced (resonance) breathing — see the science behind ONDA and what ONDA measures. The ONDA Path — its levels and higher-state language — is an experiential framework, not a hierarchy of clinically validated biological states.
how1: ONDA Life — routes (waves and levels) of simple daily steps.
howList: rely on body as a source of energy;
experience emotions as a language of connection;
use the mind for precise action;
kindle the soul by supporting others.
how2: Each practice — short breathing, attention to body, micro-movements, or contemplation.
rewards1: We provide routes, tips, and support. For practices and missions you earn OND — game currency:
rewardsList: from level 3, it can be converted to real money;
early level skills — foundation for further growth.
rewards2: Result: stable presence, calm, clarity, and inner support in life.

details.heading: ONDA Life is a practice of self-awareness and body awareness
details.p1: Connect your fitness tracker or smartwatch in settings and watch your vitals change in real time during your practice.
details.p2: The more successful you are — measured by time in practice and improvements in your state — the more OND you earn. Connecting a tracker or smartwatch will boost your earnings for completing practices.
details.p3: Once you complete all practices in a part with over 40% success, you'll unlock the next level.
details.p4: At the start of each part, you'll find general guidance before the Main Practices. At the end, there's a more detailed attunement to help you assess your current state.
details.p5: In the Emotional Check window, you can discover your current emotional state and can complete an Adaptive practice.
details.p6: Remember: the ONDA level system is a journey of realizations — experiencing yourself as an amoeba, fish, animal, primate, human, brain cell, DNA, and finally, an atom. Give each stage the attention it deserves, and your path will be effortless and fulfilling.

author.heading: The person behind ONDA Life
author.lead: ONDA Life was founded by Yakiv Bilenko — an architect and a psychologist.
author.p1: For over 20 years he has designed physical environments — homes, commercial and industrial buildings, interiors, and the planning of entire territories. For over 10 years, in parallel, he has practised as a Gestalt therapist and coach, building structured programs for the recovery of people's mental, physical and emotional resources.
author.p2: His work runs along the seam between those two fields — how the environment around a person and the environment inside them shape one another. ONDA Life is that question turned into a product: a system for working on your inner architecture with the same intent an architect brings to a building.
author.p3: ONDA Life is a Spanish company based in Avilés. Its protocols and articles are educational tools for self-directed practice, grounded in applied psychology and systems design — not medical advice or a substitute for professional care.
